newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BASSETT QUITS PALACE FOR FOREST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BASSETT QUITS PALACE FOR FOREST.

text.p: Dave Bassett surprisingly quit first division Crystal Palace after just a year in charge on Thursday to become general manager at premier league Nottingham Forest.
Bassett, 52, joins Forest just three days after the club was taken over by new owners and will work alongside caretaker player-manager Stuart Pearce.
Talking on Crystal Palace's telephone Clubcall service Bassett said: "I am sorry to be going, I think when you leave a club you are always sad, whether it's your decision or whether you are sacked.
"Whilst I have made the decision to join Nottingham Forest as general manager I do leave a lot of good, fond memories behind."
Referring to himself in the third person, he said: "It's a correct decision for Dave Bassett, for the professional and financial situation and also for me domestically."
Bassett only took over at Crystal Palace on February 8 last year and narrowly failed to win them promotion back to the premier league.
Palace have been somewhat erratic this season, but are currently sixth in the first division and in with a realistic chance of reaching the playoffs again.
Forest have improved since Pearce took over from Frank Clark in December, but are still dangerously close to relegation from the premier league.
